prompt: Challenge C061-CH1: Our cold-pressed pumpkin seed oil goes rancid within 4 months on shelf, but competitors manage 9–12 months; we lose about 15% of each batch

content.text:
The core work is identifying the main oxidation pathway in cold-pressed pumpkin seed oil and recommending process changes - this requires lipid oxidation analysis (fatty acid profiling, tocopherol content, oxidation markers, headspace oxygen measurement).

R0231 - Mirković: Perfect fit. PhD on pumpkin seed oil peroxide kinetics, has GC-FID, HPLC, Rancimat, experience with cold-press producers. Can do contract_research.

R0403 - Lazić: Fatty acid profiling, GC-MS, oxidative stability, but focus seems more on cosmetic applications. Still has relevant analytical capability. partly - can do analytical characterization but less focused on oxidation pathway diagnosis.
R0550 - Kovačević works on photo-oxidation of carotenoids in nanoemulsions, which doesn't match bulk oil lipid oxidation - cannot. R0922 - Dobanovački focuses on carotenoid/tocopherol extraction rather than oxidation pathway analysis - also cannot.
